title: spec page.zod.ts: ElementApiDataSourceSchema still describes itself as "[PLANNED — not yet rendered]" and visibleWhen says no renderer reads the binding, but the console renders both (objectui#12197)
body:
Blocked-by: #24283 (the console pin move that carries objectui `c4dd7078ed`, the `api` binding renderer — recorded by the triage seat)

Filing gate ①: class (b), a declared surface whose own text contradicts the shipped renderer, measured. Filed by `repo:cloud#2` (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the cloud#2801 dev report (cloud PR #3010). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the spec says (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`, `main` `d537a318`; the same at cloud's pin `be076dad28a0`)

- `ElementApiDataSourceSchema`'s describe (`:556`; `:509` at the pin) opens "[PLANNED — not yet rendered]". It ends "The console's generic stat, usage-bar and checklist blocks are the planned readers; until they ship, the binding parses and no block reads it."
- The `visibleWhen` docblock (`:718`; `:671` at the pin) says "No renderer reads that binding yet".

## What ships

- objectstack-ai/objectui#12197 shipped the stat, usage-bar and checklist blocks.
- objectui `c4dd7078` (cloud's console pin) renders the `api` binding: `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` `useElementApiDataSource`, which publishes the bound value as `data` to the node and its subtree, and the node's own predicate scope reads it.
- cloud's home and pricing pages are built on it (cloud#2986, and cloud PR #3010), measured on a local stack and pinned by booted tests.

## Why it matters (AI-error axis)

An author, and an AI first of all, reads "[PLANNED — not yet rendered]" and "no renderer reads that binding yet" as "do not use this". That steers authors away from a shipped, contract-checked binding.

## Wanted

- Rewrite both texts to say what the console renders today.
- If the framework's vendored console (`packages/console` dist) predates objectui#12197, say which console renders it, rather than leaving the PLANNED tag.
- A describe-text change only. No schema shape change.

Dedupe: grepped this repository's `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` history and its open issues for `PLANNED — not yet rendered` and `ElementApiDataSourceSchema`; no open card on the describe text.
